---
title: Sections
description: Every section and block in ATTAR, with its settings.
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-docs-reference.mjs from the theme schemas. Edit the schemas or the intro in that script, not this file. -->

Sections are the building blocks of each page. In the theme editor, select **Add section** to add one, or select a section in the sidebar to change its settings. Blocks are the parts inside a section; select **Add block** under a section to add one.

To change text per language, use Shopify's Translate & Adapt app; see [Languages and right-to-left]({{ site.baseurl }}/languages-and-rtl/).

**Sections you can add:** [Announcement bar](#announcement-bar), [Blog posts](#blog-posts), [Boutiques](#boutiques), [Collection banner](#collection-banner), [Collection list](#collection-list), [Compare](#compare), [Compare teaser](#compare-teaser), [Contact form](#contact-form), [Custom Liquid](#custom-liquid), [Email signup](#email-signup), [Express order](#express-order), [FAQ](#faq), [Featured product](#featured-product), [Featured products](#featured-products), [Gift wrap and message](#gift-wrap-and-message), [Hero](#hero), [Image banner](#image-banner), [Image with text](#image-with-text), [Lookbook](#lookbook), [Password](#password), [Payment and delivery](#payment-and-delivery), [Product highlights](#product-highlights), [Product recommendations](#product-recommendations), [Product reviews](#product-reviews), [Review highlight](#review-highlight), [Rich text](#rich-text), [Scent families](#scent-families), [Scent finder](#scent-finder), [Scent finder teaser](#scent-finder-teaser), [Slideshow](#slideshow), [Story chapters](#story-chapters), [Story hero](#story-hero), [Story image with text](#story-image-with-text), [Story text](#story-text), [Story values](#story-values), [Video](#video).

**Built-in sections** (already on their page, or in the header and footer): [404 page](#404-page), [Blog](#blog), [Cart](#cart), [Cart drawer](#cart-drawer), [Collection](#collection), [Collections list](#collections-list), [Footer](#footer), [Header](#header), [Product](#product), [Search](#search).

## Sections you can add

### Announcement bar

Only in the header area.

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Show announcement** | On/off | On |  |
| **Text** | Text |  | Your message, for example a delivery promise or an offer. Translate it for each language in Translate & Adapt. Leave blank to show a welcome, or the greeting of the campaign set in Theme settings. |
| **Free-shipping threshold** | Number |  | Adds “Free shipping on orders over [amount]” after the text. Enter the amount in your store currency. It’s shown only to shoppers paying in that currency, because it isn’t converted for other markets. Leave blank or 0 to hide it. |
| **Link** | Link |  | Makes the whole bar a link. Links you add in the text replace it. |

#### Quantity tiers

Off by default: leave both discounts at 0 unless your store applies them. The theme only shows tier progress and an estimated saving; it does not apply a discount. For each tier, first create a matching automatic discount in Shopify admin (Discounts › Create discount › Amount off products, Method: Automatic discount, Minimum purchase: minimum quantity of items), then enter the same numbers here.

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Tier 1: minimum units** | Slider | 6 | From 0 to 100. |
| **Tier 1: discount** | Slider | 0 % | From 0 to 50 %. |
| **Tier 2: minimum units** | Slider | 12 | From 0 to 100. |
| **Tier 2: discount** | Slider | 0 % | From 0 to 50 %. |

### Product highlights

Only in product template.

#### Blocks

**Scent pyramid** (up to 1)

Reads the notes, longevity and sillage metafields (attar.notes_top, notes_heart, notes_base, longevity, sillage and their scores). Hidden when the product has none.

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Notes display** | Choice | Note ribbon | Options: Note ribbon; Notes list. The note ribbon needs the attar.note_ribbon metafield. Products without it show the notes list. |
| **Heading** | Text |  | Leave blank to use the theme's default text in every language. |
| **Text** | Text |  | Leave blank to use the theme's default text in every language. |

**Pairs well with** (up to 1)

Shows the product in the attar.pairs_with metafield with an "Add both" button. Hidden when the metafield is empty; when either product is sold out, the combined price and the button are left out.

**Buy buttons** (up to 1)

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Show quantity selector** | On/off | On |  |

Uses the WhatsApp number in Theme settings and pre-fills the product title.

**Pay in installments** (up to 1)

Optional. Shows an estimated installment amount for Tabby or Tamara if they're turned on in Theme settings › Payments and offered at checkout. Each provider shows only in its markets: Tabby in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain and Qatar; Tamara in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Kuwait. The theme doesn't check eligibility or fees.

**Prepaid nudge** (up to 1)

Encourages prepaid orders in the cash-on-delivery markets set in Theme settings › Payments; with no markets set there, it shows in every market. Set up the matching discount in Shopify before you promise one.

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Prepaid saving** | Slider | 0 % | From 0 to 15 %. 0 hides the block. The theme doesn't apply this discount: create it in Discounts first. |

**Gift option** (up to 1)

A "This is a gift" switch with a message, gift wrapping and a no-prices choice, saved on the item as line item properties. No app needed. To print gift messages on packing slips, paste the snippet from the theme documentation (Gifting) into Settings › Shipping and delivery › Documents › Packing slip template.

| **Message length limit (characters)** | Slider | 150 | From 40 to 240. |
